Optimize Your Gaming PC

A hardware-agnostic guide for desktops and gaming laptops, any GPU vendor, and different game workloads. Diagnose first, change one relevant setting, and measure the result.

Read the complete guide Browse game guides
  1. RecordGame, scene, settings, FPS, frame time, temperatures.
  2. Change one thingOnly a setting tied to the observed problem.
  3. Repeat the testKeep the change only if the result is measurable.

Windows 11 is the primary OS covered. Windows 10 is documented separately as a legacy OS because Microsoft ended standard support on October 14, 2025. Advice is labeled when it depends on an OS version, GPU vendor, game, or hardware feature.

What is your problem?

Low FPSFind out whether the CPU, GPU, memory or disk is the limit. StuttersSeparate frame‑time spikes from background load. High temperaturesCheck throttling, cooling and safe limits. Crashes and freezesFollow a decision path from symptom to fix. Input lagReview GPU and display settings that affect latency. Not sure where to startPrepare a restore point and a baseline first.
